description: Operation-local execution outcome. Actual cumulative effectTotal is assigned, never added; it is not ledger application or root charge totals. Additional optional response members are permitted.

effectTotal.description: Cumulative normalized actual amount for this child: captured funds for capture, released authorization for void_authorization. Decimal string in money.currency with its scale. Zero means no confirmed amount recorded at this revision, not certified absence. No admission-capacity upper bound is imposed on actual evidence.

money.description: Frozen positive requested amount of this child, in the root binding currency. Not a claim that the provider applied it.

operationKind.description: Separate child wire kind; internal execution kind void maps to void_authorization. Shared v1 charge/refund enum is unchanged.

operationRef.description: Child logical operation identity; independent of transport retries.

originalOperationRef.description: Original root charge operationRef, never the latest merchant route.

providerEvidenceRef.description: Stable sanitized evidence reference, not a credential or mandatory PSP effect identifier. Same existing outcome evidence boundary.

title: Capture or authorization-void child outcome
